id_and_class.summary: Azarian argues that consciousness arises when a predictive world model, built by an organism to resist entropy, recursively models itself as the agent doing the modeling, creating a subject. Each quale is a position in a relational space of possible states, and its valence is its distance from the equilibrium the organism must maintain. He calls the result multilevel monism with strong emergence.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as a World Model That Models Its Modeler

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is what it is like to be a recursively self-modeling control architecture: an integrated world model that contains the modeler as an embodied center of perception and action.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Azarian describes an emergent identity: when the self-modeling architecture comes into existence, phenomenal subjectivity comes into existence with it. Experience depends on lower-level physical processes but is neither an illusion, an epiphenomenon, nor a mere redescription of them.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Strong emergence, meaning ontological novelty and new causal powers that extend physics without violating it, and that remain open to science.
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: The first-person perspective appears when the world model represents the organism as the perceiver and actor at the center of its own simulation. The observer is a model the system produces, which Azarian argues ends the homunculus regress without eliminating subjectivity.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia are positions occupied in a ‘dialectical information geometry’, defined by contrast with every state the system could occupy but does not. Valence comes from a state's distance from the organism's attracting set, and Azarian later leans on something close to Solms's felt affect. Mary learns something new because seeing red occupies a position that description only maps.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: One physical reality with mechanical, informational, and experiential levels, each real because it does causal work the level below cannot; generative world models; recurrent physical architectures; a real, causally potent self.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through neuroscience of recurrence and loss of consciousness, formal measures of information and entropy, and the first-person perspective the self-model creates.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Three components with separate jobs: information geometry gives the relational structure of the conscious field, self-modeling gives the first-person perspective, and affect gives qualia their felt, action-guiding character. Further loops of modeling oneself modeling oneself yield meta-awareness.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal; self-awareness and meta-awareness; valence; agency and free will; mental causation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: A level-crossing, self-referential loop in which the generative model models itself modeling the world. Integration and differentiation of information are necessary for experience but not sufficient without this loop.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness appears once a world model is integrated and temporally deep enough to include its modeler. It deepens in discrete jumps with each added level of self-modeling, not by gradual accumulation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: In recurrent physical architectures; in brains, thalamocortical and frontoparietal loops, not the largely feed-forward cerebellum.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: The self adds a layer of top-down cybernetic control that supports counterfactual simulation and, when rich enough, free will. Qualia act as ‘automatic instructions for maintaining dynamic equilibrium against entropy's tide’.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Integrated information organizes content; self-modeling then makes that content present to a subject. Azarian draws on global workspace ignition as a description of the same dynamics.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Azarian proposes repertoire entropy, the Shannon entropy of a system's viable states, as a proxy for experiential richness. It measures differentiation, while IIT's phi measures integration, and a large set of noninteracting switches has the first without the second.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Organisms must predict their environment to capture free energy and stay far from thermodynamic equilibrium. Competition ratchets model complexity upward, and Azarian treats life and mind as stages in a universe that organizes itself toward greater complexity.
core_claims_and_evidence: Consciousness is absent in the largely feed-forward cerebellum and lost when thalamocortical and frontoparietal recurrence is disrupted, consistent with a requirement for recurrent architecture.
Zombies are impossible because any physical duplicate would perform the same integrated, recurrent self-modeling.
An undetectable inverted spectrum is impossible because human color space is asymmetric.
Large language models on conventional hardware can simulate self-modeling without being a physical strange loop, so they are not conscious.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Theoretical synthesis of neuroscience, the free-energy principle, information theory, and cybernetics, with philosophical argument.

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: Comparisons of recurrent and feed-forward brain structures, and disruption of thalamocortical and frontoparietal recurrence. Azarian names rigorous formulation of repertoire entropy and qualia geometry, and their experimental demonstration, as work still to do.
empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Identity and strong emergence are asserted together, and explanatory autonomy with top-down control does not by itself show new causal powers. Recurrence, self-representation, and reflective self-awareness are different properties, and the theory must say which kind of self-modeling is needed where experience seems possible without explicit reflection. Multiple realizability sits uneasily beside strict substrate requirements.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Whether an identity can itself be emergent, and how that differs from a psychophysical law that holds once the architecture exists, awaits Azarian's fuller treatment. The synthesis has precedent in Safron's Integrated World Modeling Theory.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Azarian accepts placement in non-reductive physicalism, with Ellis and Murphy as nearest kin, but suspects the line between it and property dualism is ‘largely a language game’. He departs from Hofstadter by treating the self as real and causally potent, and he uses IIT revisionally by adding a self-modeling condition it lacks.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Consciousness is multiply realizable in principle, but it needs a physically recurrent substrate such as neuromorphic or self-organizing hardware or cultured neural tissue, not software running on conventional chips.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since the subject is generated by a physically embodied self-modeling architecture, it ends when that architecture stops.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Azarian places life and mind within a universe that organizes itself toward greater complexity, and frames consciousness as part of that cosmic process.

virtual_immortality.rationale: A simulation on conventional hardware would not be conscious; any continuation would require rebuilding the strange loop in a recurrent physical substrate.
